name: CAC Holdings Corporation
summary: CAC Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides information technology services in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, IT and Overseas IT. The company constructs and operates information systems. It also offers systems development, integration, operation, management, consulting, and maintenance, as well as BPO/BTO services; develops and sells packaged software; and plans, develops, and sells production management systems.
